clauses.quote: Fully credentialed teachers employed on December 31, 2000, and serving in the following hard-to-fill positions shall receive an annual stipend of $800 beginning with the 2000-2001 school year.
clauses.subject_text: Fully credentialed teachers employed on December 31, 2000, and serving in the following hard-to-fill positions

clauses.quote: If a teacher works more than one semester, $800 shall be paid.
If a teacher works less than a semester, $400 shall be provided.

Current employees without a credential and current fully-credentialed employees who agree to obtain a credential qualifying them for a hard-to-fill position shall receive upon completion of the credential the $800 stipend if assigned to a hard-to-fill position.
clauses.subject_text: Current employees without a credential and current fully-credentialed employees who agree to obtain a credential qualifying them for a hard-to-fill position

clauses.quote: Current employees who possess a credential qualifying them for a hard-to-fill position but are not assigned to a hard-to-fill position shall receive the stipend in item 5 below if they transfer to a hard-to-fill position.
clauses.subject_text: Current employees who possess a credential qualifying them for a hard-to-fill position but are not assigned to a hard-to-fill position
